name: niit-digital-twin
description: NIIT Digital Twin — Enterprise Digital Twin Platform (MERN POC)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run client" "npm run server"
